+        http_status: int | None = None
+        safe_error: str | None = None
+        try:
+            raw, returned = transport.call(prompt, image, max_tokens)
+            if returned.get("model") != model or returned.get("prompt_sha256") != identity["prompt_sha256"] or returned.get("image_sha256") != identity["image_sha256"]:

+        record = {
+            "attempt_number": number, "latency_seconds": elapsed,
+            "request_identity": identity, "budget": budget,
+            "raw_response_relative_path": raw_path.relative_to(attempts_dir.parent).as_posix() if raw is not None else None,
+            "raw_response_sha256": sha256_bytes(raw) if raw is not None else None,
+            "raw_response_bytes": len(raw) if raw is not None else None,

+def activation_ids(full_candidate: Any, mark_candidate: Any, source: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    if not isinstance(full_candidate, dict):
+        return []
+    activations: list[str] = []
+    stage = copy.deepcopy(full_candidate)
+    updated = candidate._filter_uppercase_choices(stage)
+    if updated != stage:
+        activations.append("unparenthesized-uppercase-choice-filter")
+    stage = updated
+    updated = candidate._qualify_repeated_romans(stage)
+    if updated != stage:
+        activations.append("stateful-repeated-roman-parent-qualification")
+    stage = updated
+    updated = candidate._recover_local_owner_reset(stage, mark_candidate, multi_page=len(source["regions"]) > 1)
+    if updated != stage:
+        activations.append("multi-page-local-owner-reset-recovery")
+    normalized, _warnings = candidate.normalize_candidate(
+        full_candidate, mark_candidate, source["question_number"], multi_page=len(source["regions"]) > 1,
+    )
+    _merged, _disposition, mark_warnings = candidate.merge_mark_pass(normalized, mark_candidate)
+    if "specialized_mark_exact_structure_replacement" in mark_warnings:
+        activations.append("exact-structure-specialized-mark-replacement")
+    return activations

+def terminal_status(classifications: list[str], evaluated: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    failures = [value for value in classifications if value != "complete"]
+    if failures:
+        first = failures[0]
+        if first in {"context_or_output_truncated", "context_length_rejected", "context_budget_exceeded_after_call"}:
+            return "context_or_truncation_terminal_failure"
+        if first == "provider_model_mismatch":
+            return "provider_model_mismatch_terminal_failure"
+        if first in {"truncated_json", "provider_provenance_incomplete"}:
+            return "schema_or_protocol_terminal_failure"
+        return "provider_or_transport_terminal_failure"
+    if evaluated.get("normalized") is None:
+        return "normalization_terminal_failure"

+def _load_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

+            "model": contract["served_model"]["id"],
+            "max_retries_per_request": MAX_RETRIES, "timeout_seconds": REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
+            **evaluated, "terminal_status": status, "repair_activations": activations,
+            "false_override": bool(baseline.get("all_field_checks_pass") and not evaluated.get("all_field_checks_pass")),
+            "activation_false_accept": bool(activations and not evaluated.get("all_field_checks_pass")),
+            "full_pass": {"classification": full_class, "attempts": full_history, "raw_candidate": full_raw},
+            "mark_pass": {"classification": mark_class, "attempts": mark_history, "raw_candidate": mark_raw},

+        completed[question_id] = terminal

+    return finalize_checkpoint(
+        checkpoint, manifest, truth, args.output_dir.resolve(), args.run_id,
+        manifest_sha, truth_sha, harness_sha,
+    )
+
+
+def _ratio(count: int, total: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"count": count, "total": total, "rate": count / total if total else 0.0}
+
+
+def finalize_checkpoint(
+    checkpoint: Path, manifest: dict[str, Any], truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    output_dir: Path, run_id: str, manifest_sha: str, truth_sha: str, harness_sha: str,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    rows = _load_rows(checkpoint)
+    indexed = candidate.predecessor.frozen.index_rows(rows, "question_id", "checkpoint")
+    expected_ids = [row["question_id"] for row in manifest["questions"]]
+    if set(indexed) != set(expected_ids):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"checkpoint_not_complete_global_stop:{len(indexed)}/{len(expected_ids)}")
+    ordered = [indexed[question_id] for question_id in expected_ids]
+    for row in ordered:
+        validate_terminal_row(row, question_id=row["question_id"], run_id=run_id, manifest_sha=manifest_sha, truth_sha=truth_sha, harness_sha=harness_sha)

+def source_hash(function: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_bytes(inspect.getsource(function).encode("utf-8"))

+
+def component_hashes() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    frozen = candidate.predecessor.frozen
+    paths = (
+        REPO / "scripts/vlm/issue_1639_quality_repair.py",
+        REPO / "scripts/vlm/__tests__/issue_1639_quality_repair.test.py",
+        REPO / "scripts/vlm/issue_1631_residual_repair.py",
+        REPO / "scripts/vlm/issue_1620_local_two_pass.py",
+        REPO / "scripts/vlm/issue_1621_unseen_batch.py",
+        CONTEXT_CONTRACT,
+    )
+    return {
+        "files": {path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(): sha256_file(path) for path in paths},
+        "prompts": {
+            "version": frozen.PROMPT_VERSION,
+            "full_prompt_template_sha256": sha256_bytes(frozen.FULL_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.encode()),
+            "mark_prompt_sha256": sha256_bytes(frozen.MARK_PROMPT.encode()),
+        },
+        "policies": {

+            "uppercase_filter_sha256": source_hash(candidate._filter_uppercase_choices),
+            "repeated_roman_sha256": source_hash(candidate._qualify_repeated_romans),
+            "continuation_owner_sha256": source_hash(candidate._recover_local_owner_reset),
+            "specialized_mark_merge_sha256": source_hash(candidate.merge_mark_pass),
+            "evaluation_sha256": source_hash(candidate.evaluate),
+            "context_budget_sha256": source_hash(candidate.context_budget),
+            "provider_audit_sha256": source_hash(candidate.audit_provider_response),
+            "http_classification_sha256": source_hash(candidate.classify_http_error),
+        },
+        "schemas": {
+            "evaluated_keys_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(list(frozen.EVALUATED_KEYS))),
+            "context_contract_sha256": sha256_file(CONTEXT_CONTRACT),

+    }

+def freeze_components(_args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    base = verify_base()
+    hashes = component_hashes()
+    files = hashes["files"]
+    if files["scripts/vlm/issue_1639_quality_repair.py"] != FROZEN_RUNNER_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("issue_1639_runner_hash_drift_global_stop")
+    if files["scripts/vlm/__tests__/issue_1639_quality_repair.test.py"] != FROZEN_TEST_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("issue_1639_test_hash_drift_global_stop")
+    if files[CONTEXT_CONTRACT.relative_to(REPO).as_posix()] != FROZEN_CONTEXT_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("issue_1639_context_contract_hash_drift_global_stop")
+    receipt = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_generalization_holdout_component_freeze_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "status": "pass",
+        "frozen_before_population_selection": True,
+        "provider_calls_at_freeze": 0,
+        "base": base,
+        "candidate_behavior_source": "exact_issue_1639_state_merged_by_pr_1640",
+        "component_hashes": hashes,
+        "execution_contract": {
+            "local_ai2_pc_only": True,
+            "concurrency": 1,
+            "max_retries": MAX_RETRIES,
+            "timeout_seconds": REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
+            "context_contract": read_json(CONTEXT_CONTRACT),
+            "paid_external_calls": 0,

+    write_once(COMPONENT_FREEZE, receipt)

+def verify_component_freeze() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not COMPONENT_FREEZE.is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError("component_freeze_missing_global_stop")
+    receipt = read_json(COMPONENT_FREEZE)
+    if receipt.get("status") != "pass" or receipt.get("component_hashes") != component_hashes():
+        raise RuntimeError("component_freeze_drift_global_stop")

+def prior_membership() -> tuple[set[str], dict[str, Any]]:
+    combined: list[str] = []
+    sources = []
+    for path, key, expected_count in PRIOR_SOURCES:
+        rows = read_json(path).get(key)
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_rows_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        ids = [row.get("question_id") for row in rows if isinstance(row, dict)]
+        if len(ids) != expected_count or len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or any(not isinstance(x, str) or not x for x in ids):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        combined.extend(ids)
+        sources.append({
+            "path": path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+            "question_count": len(ids),
+            "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(ids)),
+        })
+    if len(combined) != 462 or len(set(combined)) != 462:
+        raise RuntimeError("prior_unique_462_recomputation_failed_global_stop")
+    return set(combined), {
+        "schema_version": "9709_prior_population_exclusion_ledger_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "unique_question_count": 462,
+        "duplicate_count": 0,
+        "empty_id_count": 0,
+        "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(sorted(combined))),
+        "sources": sources,
+        "question_ids": sorted(combined),
+    }

+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> tuple[str, int, int, int]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])(\d\d)_qp_([1-6])(\d)", paper_id)
+    if not match:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"paper_identity_invalid_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+    session, year, component, variant = match.groups()
+    return session, 2000 + int(year), int(component), int(variant)
+
+
+def surface_manifest_path(paper_id: str) -> Path:
+    session, year, component, _variant = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+    if year == 2025:
+        return REPO / f"data/manifests/9709_p{component}_{session}25_standard_001_page_chain_surface_v2.json"
+    return REPO / f"data/manifests/9709_p{component}_{session}_standard_001_page_chain_surface_v1.json"

+def canonical_authority() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    document = read_json(CANONICAL_SOURCE_INVENTORY)
+    rows = document.get("canonical_rows")
+    if not isinstance(rows, list) or document.get("freeze_blockers") != []:
+        raise RuntimeError("canonical_source_authority_invalid_global_stop")
+    indexed: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for row in rows:
+        name = row.get("source_filename")
+        if not isinstance(name, str) or name in indexed:
+            raise RuntimeError("canonical_source_filename_invalid_global_stop")
+        indexed[name] = row
+    return indexed

+def population() -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    verify_component_freeze()
+    prior, exclusion = prior_membership()
+    authority = canonical_authority()
+    papers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    questions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    surfaces: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    overlap: list[str] = []
+    for paper_id in PAPERS:
+        manifest_path = surface_manifest_path(paper_id)
+        surfaces[manifest_path.as_posix()] = {
+            "path": manifest_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(manifest_path),
+        }
+        items = [
+            item for item in read_json(manifest_path).get("items", [])
+            if Path(str(item.get("source_pdf", ""))).stem == paper_id
+        ]
+        items.sort(key=lambda row: row.get("q_number", 0))
+        numbers = [item.get("q_number") for item in items]
+        if not numbers or numbers != list(range(1, max(numbers) + 1)):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"complete_paper_membership_invalid_global_stop:{paper_id}:{numbers}")
+        source_paths = {item.get("source_pdf") for item in items}
+        if len(source_paths) != 1:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"paper_source_ambiguous_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        qp_relative = next(iter(source_paths))
+        qp_path = REPO / str(qp_relative)
+        ms_name = paper_id.replace("_qp_", "_ms_") + ".pdf"
+        qp_auth = authority.get(paper_id + ".pdf")
+        ms_auth = authority.get(ms_name)
+        if not qp_path.is_file() or qp_path.name.startswith("WM_") or not qp_auth or not ms_auth:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"official_qp_ms_authority_missing_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        ms_path = REPO / str(ms_auth["source_path"])
+        if not ms_path.is_file() or sha256_file(qp_path) != qp_auth["sha256"] or sha256_file(ms_path) != ms_auth["sha256"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"official_qp_ms_hash_mismatch_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        session, year, component, variant = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+        papers.append({
+            "paper_id": paper_id, "component": f"P{component}", "session": session,
+            "year": year, "variant": variant, "question_count": len(items),
+            "question_paper": {"path": str(qp_relative), "sha256": sha256_file(qp_path)},
+            "mark_scheme": {"path": ms_auth["source_path"], "sha256": sha256_file(ms_path)},
+            "selection_posture": "complete_official_qp_ms_pair",
+        })
+        for item in items:
+            question_id = f"{paper_id}_q{item['q_number']:02d}"
+            if question_id in prior:
+                overlap.append(question_id)
+            questions.append({
+                "question_id": question_id, "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "question_number": item["q_number"], "source_pdf": str(qp_relative),
+                "surface_manifest": manifest_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+                "surface_storage_key": item.get("storage_key"),
+                "navigation_page_indices": historical.navigation_page_indices(item),
+            })
+    counts = Counter(row["component"] for row in papers)
+    if overlap:
+        raise RuntimeError("prior_population_overlap_global_stop:" + ",".join(overlap))
+    ids = [row["question_id"] for row in questions]
+    if len(papers) != 42 or len(questions) != 340 or len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"population_42_340_gate_failed_global_stop:{len(papers)}:{len(questions)}")
+    if set(counts) != {f"P{x}" for x in range(1, 7)}:
+        raise RuntimeError("population_component_coverage_failed_global_stop")
+    if len({row["session"] for row in papers}) < 3 or len({row["year"] for row in papers}) < 3:
+        raise RuntimeError("population_session_year_coverage_failed_global_stop")
+    source = {
+        "paper_count": len(papers), "question_count": len(questions),
+        "paper_family_counts": dict(sorted(counts.items())),
+        "session_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(row["session"] for row in papers).items())),
+        "year_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(str(row["year"]) for row in papers).items())),
+        "prior_unique_exclusion_count": 462, "exact_overlap_count": 0,
+        "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(ids)),
+        "source_surface_manifests": sorted(surfaces.values(), key=lambda row: row["path"]),
+        "canonical_source_inventory": {
+            "path": CANONICAL_SOURCE_INVENTORY.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(CANONICAL_SOURCE_INVENTORY),
+        },
+    }
+    return papers, questions, source, exclusion
+

+def inventory(_args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    papers, questions, source, exclusion = population()
+    return {
+        "status": "eligible", **source,
+        "paper_ids": [row["paper_id"] for row in papers],
+        "prior_exclusion_question_ids_sha256": exclusion["question_ids_sha256"],

+def render_and_extract(
+    row: dict[str, Any], paper_count: int, freeze_root: Path,
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any], list[int]]:
+    """Render an authoritative chain and extract literal labels/marks.
+
+    Unlike the older holdout helper, this permits printed instruction labels
+    with no mark directly attached (for example (ii) followed by (a)/(b)).
+    Ownership still comes only from the nearest preceding printed label and is
+    subsequently confirmed on the contact sheet.
+    """
+    fitz = historical._fitz()
+    source_pdf = REPO / row["source_pdf"]
+    question_number = row["question_number"]
+    regions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    label_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, str]] = []
+    mark_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, int]] = []
+    current_parent: str | None = None
+    with fitz.open(str(source_pdf)) as document:
+        headers = historical.question_headers(document, paper_count)
+        start_page, start_y = headers[question_number]
+        next_header = headers.get(question_number + 1)
+        navigation_pages = row["navigation_page_indices"]
+        if start_page != navigation_pages[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"navigation_start_page_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if next_header:
+            next_page, next_y = next_header
+            last_page = next_page - 1 if next_page > start_page and next_y < 120 else next_page
+            pages = list(range(start_page, last_page + 1))
+        else:
+            last_mark_pages = [
+                page_index for page_index in range(start_page, len(document))
+                if any(historical.MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(word[4])) for word in document[page_index].get_text("words"))
+            ]
+            if not last_mark_pages:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"last_question_authoritative_end_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            pages = list(range(start_page, max(last_mark_pages) + 1))
+        pages = [page_index for page_index in pages if "BLANK PAGE" not in document[page_index].get_text().upper()]
+        if not pages or pages[0] != start_page:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_question_pages_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for ordinal, page_index in enumerate(pages, 1):
+            page = document[page_index]
+            top = max(42.0, start_y - 8.0) if page_index == start_page else 42.0
+            bottom = min(float(page.rect.height) - 35.0, 807.0)
+            if next_header and next_header[0] == page_index:
+                bottom = min(bottom, next_header[1] - 8.0)
+            if bottom <= top:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_crop_geometry_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            box = [0.0, round(top, 3), round(float(page.rect.width), 3), round(bottom, 3)]
+            pixmap = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0), clip=fitz.Rect(*box), alpha=False)
+            payload = pixmap.tobytes("png")
+            crop_path = freeze_root / "crops" / row["paper_id"] / row["question_id"] / f"region-{ordinal:02d}-page-{page_index + 1:02d}.png"
+            candidate.predecessor.frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(crop_path, payload)
+            regions.append({
+                "region_id": f"{row['question_id']}:region:{ordinal}",
+                "page_number": page_index + 1, "crop_box_pdf_points": box,
+                "crop_external_path": str(crop_path.resolve()), "crop_sha256": sha256_bytes(payload),
+                "render_engine": "PyMuPDF", "render_scale": 2.0,
+            })
+            clip = fitz.Rect(*box)
+            for word in page.get_text("words", clip=clip):
+                x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_rest = word
+                label_match = historical.LABEL_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if label_match and x0 < 180:
+                    label = label_match.group(1).lower()
+                    if label in historical.ROMANS and current_parent:
+                        label = f"{current_parent}({label})"
+                    elif label not in historical.ROMANS:
+                        current_parent = label
+                    label_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), label))
+                mark_match = historical.MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if mark_match:
+                    mark_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), int(mark_match.group(1))))
+    visible: list[str] = []
+    for *_position, label in label_events:
+        if label not in visible:
+            visible.append(label)
+    marks = []
+    for page_index, y0, x0, value in mark_events:
+        preceding = [event for event in label_events if (event[0], event[1], event[2]) <= (page_index, y0 + 3.0, x0)]
+        owner = preceding[-1][3] if preceding else "question"
+        if owner != "question" and owner not in visible:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_owner_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        marks.append({"owner": owner, "marks": value})
+    if not marks:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_marks_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+    expected = {
+        "question_number": question_number, "visible_subparts": visible, "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": False, "foreign_annotation_present": False,
+    }
+    return regions, expected, pages
+
+
+def validate_expected(expected: Any, question_number: int, question_id: str) -> None:
+    keys = {
+        "question_number", "visible_subparts", "visible_marks",
+        "candidate_writing_present", "foreign_annotation_present",
+    }
+    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or set(expected) != keys:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_schema_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if type(expected["question_number"]) is not int or expected["question_number"] != question_number:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_question_identity_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    parts = expected["visible_subparts"]
+    marks = expected["visible_marks"]
+    if (
+        not isinstance(parts, list) or len(parts) != len(set(parts))
+        or any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in parts)
+        or not isinstance(marks, list) or not marks
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_structure_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    for row in marks:
+        if (
+            not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"owner", "marks"}
+            or not isinstance(row["owner"], str)
+            or row["owner"] not in ({"question"} | set(parts))
+            or type(row["marks"]) is not int or row["marks"] <= 0
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"truth_mark_owner_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if expected["candidate_writing_present"] is not False or expected["foreign_annotation_present"] is not False:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_clean_source_scalar_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+
+
+def prepare_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    papers, population_rows, source, exclusion = population()
+    freeze_root = (args.run_root / "frozen-inputs").resolve()
+    paper_counts = {row["paper_id"]: row["question_count"] for row in papers}
+    review_rows = []
+    for row in population_rows:
+        regions, expected, pages = render_and_extract(row, paper_counts[row["paper_id"]], freeze_root)
+        review_rows.append({
+            **row, "complete_page_chain": [region["page_number"] for region in regions],
+            "authoritative_page_indices": pages,
+            "navigation_page_chain_match": pages == row["navigation_page_indices"],
+            "regions": regions, "provisional_expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "pending_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+        })
+    sheets = []
+    for paper in papers:
+        rows = [row for row in review_rows if row["paper_id"] == paper["paper_id"]]
+        mark_total = sum(mark["marks"] for row in rows for mark in row["provisional_expected"]["visible_marks"])
+        expected_total = 75 if paper["component"] in {"P1", "P3"} else 50
+        if mark_total != expected_total:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"whole_paper_mark_total_mismatch_global_stop:{paper['paper_id']}:{mark_total}")
+        path = (args.run_root / "review-sheets" / f"{paper['paper_id']}.png").resolve()
+        sheets.append({
+            "paper_id": paper["paper_id"], "path": str(path),
+            "sha256": historical.build_contact_sheet(paper["paper_id"], rows, path),
+            "question_count": len(rows), "visible_mark_total": mark_total,
+            "authoritative_complete_page_chain_status": "pending_visual_confirmation",
+        })
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_generalization_holdout_visual_review_draft_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE, "candidate_responses_used": False, "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "component_freeze_sha256": sha256_file(COMPONENT_FREEZE),
+        "source": source, "exclusion_ledger": exclusion,
+        "papers": papers, "review_sheets": sheets, "rows": review_rows,
+    }
+    write_once(args.review_draft, payload)
+    return {
+        "status": "awaiting_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+        "review_draft": str(args.review_draft), "review_draft_sha256": sha256_file(args.review_draft),
+        "paper_count": len(papers), "question_count": len(review_rows), "provider_calls": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def accept_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if args.confirm != "candidate-blind-visual-review-complete":
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_confirmation_missing_global_stop")
+    draft = read_json(args.review_draft)
+    if sha256_file(args.review_draft) != args.review_draft_sha256:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    if draft.get("candidate_responses_used") is not False or draft.get("provider_call_count") != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_not_candidate_blind_global_stop")
+    overrides: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if args.overrides:
+        document = read_json(args.overrides)
+        rows = document.get("overrides")
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            raise RuntimeError("visual_review_overrides_invalid_global_stop")
+        for row in rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            if not isinstance(question_id, str) or question_id in overrides:
+                raise RuntimeError("visual_review_override_identity_invalid_global_stop")
+            overrides[question_id] = row.get("expected")
+    known = {row["question_id"] for row in draft["rows"]}
+    if set(overrides) - known:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_foreign_override_global_stop")
+    rows = []
+    for row in draft["rows"]:
+        expected = overrides.get(row["question_id"], row["provisional_expected"])
+        validate_expected(expected, row["question_number"], row["question_id"])
+        rows.append({
+            **row, "provisional_expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "accepted_candidate_blind_complete_page_chain_visual_review",
+            "truth_override_applied": row["question_id"] in overrides,
+        })
+    sheets = [
+        {**row, "authoritative_complete_page_chain_status": "visually_confirmed"}
+        for row in draft["review_sheets"]
+    ]
+    review = {
+        **draft,
+        "schema_version": "9709_generalization_holdout_candidate_blind_visual_review_v1",
+        "review_status": "accepted",
+        "review_method": "codex_visual_inspection_of_every_authoritative_complete_question_page_chain_contact_sheet",
+        "reviewed_question_count": len(rows), "reviewed_paper_count": len(sheets),
+        "truth_override_count": len(overrides), "review_sheets": sheets, "rows": rows,
+    }
+    write_once(args.review, review)
+    return {"status": "accepted", "path": str(args.review), "sha256": sha256_file(args.review), "overrides": len(overrides)}
+
+
+def freeze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    component_receipt = verify_component_freeze()
+    origin = git_value("rev-parse", "origin/main")
+    baseline = git_value("rev-parse", "baseline/origin-main")
+    task_base = git_value("merge-base", "HEAD", "origin/main")
+    if origin != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA or baseline != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA or task_base != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA:
+        raise RuntimeError("final_freeze_base_relationship_drift_global_stop")
+    review = read_json(args.review)
+    if review.get("review_status") != "accepted" or review.get("candidate_responses_used") is not False:
+        raise RuntimeError("accepted_candidate_blind_review_missing_global_stop")
+    papers, questions, source, exclusion = population()
+    reviewed = candidate.predecessor.frozen.index_rows(review.get("rows"), "question_id", "visual_review")
+    if set(reviewed) != {row["question_id"] for row in questions}:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_population_mismatch_global_stop")
+    frozen_questions = []
+    truth_rows = []
+    for question in questions:
+        row = reviewed[question["question_id"]]
+        if row.get("review_status") != "accepted_candidate_blind_complete_page_chain_visual_review":
+            raise RuntimeError(f"visual_review_row_unaccepted_global_stop:{question['question_id']}")
+        regions = row["regions"]
+        full_image, mark_image = candidate.predecessor.frozen.build_question_images(regions)
+        frozen_questions.append({
+            "question_id": question["question_id"], "paper_id": question["paper_id"],
+            "question_number": question["question_number"],
+            "complete_page_chain": row["complete_page_chain"], "regions": regions,
+            "pre_call_rendered_image_sha256": {
+                "full_question": sha256_bytes(full_image["bytes"]),
+                "right_edge_marks": sha256_bytes(mark_image["bytes"]),
+            },
+            "source_surface_manifest": question["surface_manifest"],
+            "source_surface_storage_key": question["surface_storage_key"],
+        })
+        truth_rows.append({
+            "question_id": question["question_id"], "paper_id": question["paper_id"],
+            "complete_page_chain": row["complete_page_chain"],
+            "fresh_region_sha256": [region["crop_sha256"] for region in regions],
+            "derivation": "candidate_blind_visual_review_of_authoritative_complete_page_chain",
+            "review_status": row["review_status"], "expected": row["provisional_expected"],
+        })
+    truth = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_generalization_holdout_independent_truth_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE, "frozen_before_provider_calls": True,
+        "candidate_responses_used_for_truth_derivation": False,
+        "truth_changes_after_first_response": 0, "rows": truth_rows,
+    }
+    write_once(args.truth, truth)
+    write_once(args.exclusion, exclusion)
+    final_freeze = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_generalization_holdout_pre_response_full_freeze_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE, "status": "pass", "first_response_authority": True,
+        "provider_calls_at_freeze": 0,
+        "supersedes_for_first_response": {
+            "path": COMPONENT_FREEZE.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(COMPONENT_FREEZE),
+            "retained_scope": "pre_selection_candidate_component_freeze_only",
+            "reason": "the final receipt additionally binds the stabilized issue_1641 crop truth and validator harness",
+        },
+        "base": {"required_sha": REQUIRED_BASE_SHA, "origin_main": origin, "baseline_origin_main": baseline, "task_base": task_base, "head": git_value("rev-parse", "HEAD")},
+        "candidate_component_hashes": component_receipt["component_hashes"],
+        "execution_harness": {"path": Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(Path(__file__).resolve())},
+        "crop_truth_validator_source_hashes": {
+            "population_sha256": source_hash(population),
+            "page_chain_crop_truth_extractor_sha256": source_hash(render_and_extract),
+            "visual_review_acceptor_sha256": source_hash(accept_review),
+            "frozen_input_validator_sha256": source_hash(validate_frozen_inputs),
+            "context_guarded_call_sha256": source_hash(guarded_call),
+            "terminal_classifier_sha256": source_hash(terminal_status),
+            "checkpoint_finalizer_sha256": source_hash(finalize_checkpoint),
+        },
+        "frozen_evidence": {
+            "population_question_ids_sha256": source["question_ids_sha256"],
+            "frozen_questions_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(frozen_questions)),
+            "visual_review_sha256": sha256_file(args.review),
+            "truth_sha256": sha256_file(args.truth),
+            "prior_exclusion_sha256": sha256_file(args.exclusion),
+            "context_contract_sha256": sha256_file(CONTEXT_CONTRACT),
+        },
+        "invariants": {
+            "paper_count": 42, "question_count": 340, "prior_unique_exclusion_count": 462,
+            "prior_overlap_count": 0, "candidate_responses_used_for_truth": False,
+            "truth_changes_after_first_response": 0, "concurrency": 1,
+            "paid_external_calls": 0, "canonical_production_public_remote_writes": 0,
+        },
+    }
+    write_once(FINAL_FREEZE, final_freeze)
+    manifest = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_generalization_holdout_frozen_manifest_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE, "self_sha256_omitted": True,
+        "base": {"required_sha": REQUIRED_BASE_SHA, "pr_1640_merge_sha": REQUIRED_BASE_SHA},
+        "frozen_before_provider_calls": True, "provider_calls_at_freeze": 0,
+        "candidate_only_not_canonical_truth": True,
+        "component_freeze": {"path": COMPONENT_FREEZE.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(COMPONENT_FREEZE)},
+        "first_response_full_freeze": {"path": FINAL_FREEZE.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(FINAL_FREEZE)},
+        "runner": {
+            "candidate_behavior_path": "scripts/vlm/issue_1639_quality_repair.py",
+            "candidate_behavior_sha256": FROZEN_RUNNER_SHA256,
+            "execution_harness_path": Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "execution_harness_sha256": sha256_file(Path(__file__).resolve()),
+            "component_hashes": component_receipt["component_hashes"],
+        },
+        "source": {**source, "prior_exclusion_ledger": {"path": args.exclusion.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(args.exclusion)}},
+        "visual_review": {"path": args.review.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(args.review), "question_count": 340},
+        "independent_truth": {"path": args.truth.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(args.truth), "candidate_responses_used": False},
+        "execution_contract": {
+            "concurrency": 1, "max_retries_per_request": MAX_RETRIES,
+            "timeout_seconds": REQUEST_TIMEOUT, "checkpoint_after_every_question": True,
+            "resume_idempotent": True, "row_terminal_failures_continue": True,
+            "context_contract_sha256": FROZEN_CONTEXT_SHA256,
+            "paid_external_calls": 0, "canonical_production_public_remote_writes": 0,
+        },
+        "papers": papers, "questions": frozen_questions,
+    }
+    write_once(args.manifest, manifest)
+    return {
+        "status": "frozen", "manifest": str(args.manifest), "manifest_sha256": sha256_file(args.manifest),
+        "truth_sha256": sha256_file(args.truth), "review_sha256": sha256_file(args.review),
+        "paper_count": len(papers), "question_count": len(frozen_questions), "provider_calls": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def resolve_repo_file(path: Path, label: str) -> Path:
+    resolved = (path if path.is_absolute() else REPO / path).resolve()
+    try:
+        resolved.relative_to(REPO.resolve())
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{label}_outside_repo_global_stop") from error
+    if not resolved.is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{label}_missing_global_stop")
+    return resolved
+
+
+def validate_frozen_inputs(
+    manifest_path: Path, expected_manifest_sha: str, truth_path: Path,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
+    verify_component_freeze()
+    if sha256_file(manifest_path) != expected_manifest_sha:
+        raise RuntimeError("manifest_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    manifest = read_json(manifest_path)
+    if manifest.get("base", {}).get("required_sha") != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA:
+        raise RuntimeError("manifest_base_binding_invalid_global_stop")
+    if manifest.get("runner", {}).get("candidate_behavior_sha256") != FROZEN_RUNNER_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("candidate_runner_binding_invalid_global_stop")
+    if manifest.get("runner", {}).get("execution_harness_sha256") != sha256_file(Path(__file__).resolve()):
+        raise RuntimeError("execution_harness_drift_global_stop")
+    if manifest.get("runner", {}).get("component_hashes") != component_hashes():
+        raise RuntimeError("frozen_component_drift_global_stop")
+    full_freeze_path = resolve_repo_file(Path(manifest.get("first_response_full_freeze", {}).get("path", "")), "full_freeze")
+    if sha256_file(full_freeze_path) != manifest.get("first_response_full_freeze", {}).get("sha256"):
+        raise RuntimeError("full_freeze_binding_mismatch_global_stop")
+    full_freeze = read_json(full_freeze_path)
+    if (
+        full_freeze.get("status") != "pass"
+        or full_freeze.get("first_response_authority") is not True
+        or full_freeze.get("provider_calls_at_freeze") != 0
+        or full_freeze.get("execution_harness", {}).get("sha256") != sha256_file(Path(__file__).resolve())
+        or full_freeze.get("candidate_component_hashes") != component_hashes()
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("full_freeze_drift_global_stop")
+    if manifest.get("execution_contract", {}).get("context_contract_sha256") != sha256_file(CONTEXT_CONTRACT):
+        raise RuntimeError("context_contract_binding_invalid_global_stop")
+    questions = candidate.predecessor.frozen.index_rows(manifest.get("questions"), "question_id", "manifest_question")
+    papers = candidate.predecessor.frozen.index_rows(manifest.get("papers"), "paper_id", "manifest_paper")
+    if len(questions) != 340 or len(papers) != 42:
+        raise RuntimeError("frozen_population_count_invalid_global_stop")
+    bound_truth = resolve_repo_file(Path(manifest["independent_truth"]["path"]), "truth")
+    if bound_truth != truth_path.resolve() or sha256_file(bound_truth) != manifest["independent_truth"]["sha256"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("truth_binding_mismatch_global_stop")
+    truth_document = read_json(bound_truth)
+    if truth_document.get("candidate_responses_used_for_truth_derivation") is not False or truth_document.get("truth_changes_after_first_response") != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("truth_candidate_blind_freeze_invalid_global_stop")
+    truth = candidate.predecessor.frozen.index_rows(truth_document.get("rows"), "question_id", "truth")
+    if set(truth) != set(questions):
+        raise RuntimeError("truth_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+    evidence = full_freeze.get("frozen_evidence", {})
+    if (
+        evidence.get("truth_sha256") != sha256_file(bound_truth)
+        or evidence.get("frozen_questions_sha256") != sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(manifest["questions"]))
+        or evidence.get("population_question_ids_sha256") != manifest.get("source", {}).get("question_ids_sha256")
+        or evidence.get("context_contract_sha256") != sha256_file(CONTEXT_CONTRACT)
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("full_freeze_evidence_drift_global_stop")
+    prior, _receipt = prior_membership()
+    if prior & set(questions):
+        raise RuntimeError("frozen_prior_overlap_global_stop")
+    for question_id, question in questions.items():
+        validate_expected(truth[question_id]["expected"], question["question_number"], question_id)
+        pages = []
+        for region in question.get("regions", []):
+            crop = Path(str(region.get("crop_external_path", "")))
+            if not crop.is_file() or sha256_file(crop) != region.get("crop_sha256"):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"frozen_crop_hash_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+            pages.append(region.get("page_number"))
+        if pages != question.get("complete_page_chain"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"frozen_page_chain_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    return manifest, truth
+
+
+def request_identity(prompt: str, image: dict[str, Any], max_tokens: int, pass_name: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    contract = read_json(CONTEXT_CONTRACT)
+    model = contract["served_model"]["id"]
+    base_url = contract["provider"]["base_url"].rstrip("/")
+    budget = candidate.context_budget(prompt=prompt, image_count=1, requested_output_tokens=max_tokens)
+    identity = {
+        "model": model, "endpoint": base_url + "/chat/completions",
+        "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": max_tokens,
+        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"}, "pass": pass_name,
+        "prompt_version": candidate.predecessor.frozen.PROMPT_VERSION,
+        "prompt_sha256": sha256_bytes(prompt.encode()),
+        "image_sha256": sha256_bytes(image["bytes"]),
+        "image_dimensions": image["dimensions"], "image_bytes": len(image["bytes"]),
+        "timeout_seconds": REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
+    }
+    return identity, budget
+
+
+def _attempt_paths(attempts_dir: Path, pass_name: str, number: int) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
+    prefix = attempts_dir / f"{pass_name}-{number:02d}"
+    return prefix.with_suffix(".response.raw.json"), prefix.with_suffix(".metadata.json")
+
+
+def _classify_raw(raw: bytes, budget: dict[str, Any], model: str) -> tuple[Any | None, dict[str, Any]]:
+    try:
+        document = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
+    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        return None, {"classification": "truncated_json", "semantic_eligible": False}
+    audit = candidate.audit_provider_response(document, budget)
+    if audit.get("semantic_eligible") is not True:
+        return None, audit
+    if document.get("model") != model:
+        return None, {
+            **audit, "classification": "provider_model_mismatch", "semantic_eligible": False,
+            "response_model": document.get("model"),
+        }
+    try:
+        parsed, _content = candidate.predecessor.frozen.base.parse_provider_response(document)
+    except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        return None, {**audit, "classification": "truncated_json", "semantic_eligible": False}
+    return parsed, {**audit, "response_model": document.get("model")}
+
+
+def guarded_call(
+    transport: Any, prompt: str, image: dict[str, Any], max_tokens: int,
+    attempts_dir: Path, pass_name: str, max_retries: int,
+) -> tuple[Any | None, list[dict[str, Any]], str]:
+    identity, budget = request_identity(prompt, image, max_tokens, pass_name)
+    serialized_guard = (prompt + json.dumps(identity, sort_keys=True)).lower()
+    if any(term in serialized_guard for term in FORBIDDEN_PAYLOAD_TERMS):
+        raise RuntimeError("forbidden_candidate_payload_global_stop")
+    history: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    retryable = {"provider_or_transport_failure", "truncated_json", "provider_provenance_incomplete"}
+    model = identity["model"]
+    for number in range(1, max_retries + 2):
+        raw_path, metadata_path = _attempt_paths(attempts_dir, pass_name, number)
+        if metadata_path.is_file():
+            record = read_json(metadata_path)
+            if record.get("request_identity") != identity or record.get("budget") != budget:
+                raise RuntimeError("persisted_request_provenance_drift_global_stop")
+            if record.get("raw_response_sha256") is not None:
+                if not raw_path.is_file() or sha256_file(raw_path) != record["raw_response_sha256"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("persisted_raw_response_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+                parsed, audit = _classify_raw(raw_path.read_bytes(), budget, model)
+                if audit.get("classification") != record.get("classification"):
+                    raise RuntimeError("persisted_response_classification_drift_global_stop")
+            else:
+                parsed = None
+            history.append(record)
+            if record.get("semantic_eligible") is True:
+                return parsed, history, "complete"
+            if record.get("classification") not in retryable:
+                return None, history, str(record.get("classification"))
+            continue
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        raw: bytes | None = None
+        parsed: Any = None
+        audit: dict[str, Any] = {"classification": "provider_or_transport_failure", "semantic_eligible": False}
+        http_status: int | None = None
+        safe_error: str | None = None
+        try:
+            raw, returned = transport.call(prompt, image, max_tokens)
+            if returned.get("model") != model or returned.get("prompt_sha256") != identity["prompt_sha256"] or returned.get("image_sha256") != identity["image_sha256"]:
+                raise RuntimeError("transport_request_identity_mismatch_global_stop")
+            candidate.predecessor.frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(raw_path, raw)
+            parsed, audit = _classify_raw(raw, budget, model)
+            http_status = 200
+        except candidate.predecessor.frozen.base.CapturedHTTPError as error:
+            raw = error.body
+            http_status = error.status
+            candidate.predecessor.frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(raw_path, raw)
+            body = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+            audit = {"classification": candidate.classify_http_error(error.status, body), "semantic_eligible": False}
+            safe_error = f"CapturedHTTPError:http_status_{error.status}"
+        except (OSError, TimeoutError, urllib.error.URLError) as error:
+            safe_error = f"{type(error).__name__}:{str(error).replace(transport.api_key, '<redacted>')}"
+        elapsed = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
+        record = {
+            "attempt_number": number, "latency_seconds": elapsed,
+            "request_identity": identity, "budget": budget,
+            "raw_response_relative_path": raw_path.relative_to(attempts_dir.parent).as_posix() if raw is not None else None,
+            "raw_response_sha256": sha256_bytes(raw) if raw is not None else None,
+            "raw_response_bytes": len(raw) if raw is not None else None,
+            "http_status": http_status, "classification": audit["classification"],
+            "semantic_eligible": audit.get("semantic_eligible") is True,
+            "finish_reason": audit.get("finish_reason"), "usage": audit.get("usage"),
+            "response_model": audit.get("response_model"), "error": safe_error,
+        }
+        write_once(metadata_path, record)
+        history.append(record)
+        if record["semantic_eligible"]:
+            return parsed, history, "complete"
+        if record["classification"] not in retryable:
+            return None, history, record["classification"]
+        if number <= max_retries:
+            time.sleep(float(number))
+    return None, history, str(history[-1]["classification"])
+
+
+def activation_ids(full_candidate: Any, mark_candidate: Any, source: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    if not isinstance(full_candidate, dict):
+        return []
+    activations: list[str] = []
+    stage = copy.deepcopy(full_candidate)
+    updated = candidate._filter_uppercase_choices(stage)
+    if updated != stage:
+        activations.append("unparenthesized-uppercase-choice-filter")
+    stage = updated
+    updated = candidate._qualify_repeated_romans(stage)
+    if updated != stage:
+        activations.append("stateful-repeated-roman-parent-qualification")
+    stage = updated
+    updated = candidate._recover_local_owner_reset(stage, mark_candidate, multi_page=len(source["regions"]) > 1)
+    if updated != stage:
+        activations.append("multi-page-local-owner-reset-recovery")
+    normalized, _warnings = candidate.normalize_candidate(
+        full_candidate, mark_candidate, source["question_number"], multi_page=len(source["regions"]) > 1,
+    )
+    _merged, _disposition, mark_warnings = candidate.merge_mark_pass(normalized, mark_candidate)
+    if "specialized_mark_exact_structure_replacement" in mark_warnings:
+        activations.append("exact-structure-specialized-mark-replacement")
+    return activations
+
+
+def terminal_status(classifications: list[str], evaluated: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    failures = [value for value in classifications if value != "complete"]
+    if failures:
+        first = failures[0]
+        if first in {"context_or_output_truncated", "context_length_rejected", "context_budget_exceeded_after_call"}:
+            return "context_or_truncation_terminal_failure"
+        if first == "provider_model_mismatch":
+            return "provider_model_mismatch_terminal_failure"
+        if first in {"truncated_json", "provider_provenance_incomplete"}:
+            return "schema_or_protocol_terminal_failure"
+        return "provider_or_transport_terminal_failure"
+    if evaluated.get("normalized") is None:
+        return "normalization_terminal_failure"
+    return "candidate_complete" if evaluated.get("all_field_checks_pass") else "candidate_complete_with_residual"
+
+
+def validate_terminal_row(
+    row: dict[str, Any], *, question_id: str, run_id: str,
+    manifest_sha: str, truth_sha: str, harness_sha: str,
+) -> None:
+    expected = {
+        "issue": ISSUE, "question_id": question_id, "run_id": run_id,
+        "input_manifest_sha256": manifest_sha, "independent_truth_sha256": truth_sha,
+        "execution_harness_sha256": harness_sha,
+        "candidate_behavior_sha256": FROZEN_RUNNER_SHA256,
+        "model": read_json(CONTEXT_CONTRACT)["served_model"]["id"],
+        "max_retries_per_request": MAX_RETRIES, "timeout_seconds": REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
+    }
+    if any(row.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"terminal_provenance_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+
+
+def append_checkpoint(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with path.open("ab") as handle:
+        handle.write(canonical_bytes(value))
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+
+
+def _load_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return []
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
+
+def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if args.max_retries != MAX_RETRIES or args.timeout != REQUEST_TIMEOUT:
+        raise RuntimeError("execution_contract_mismatch_global_stop")
+    manifest_path = resolve_repo_file(args.manifest, "manifest")
+    truth_path = resolve_repo_file(args.truth, "truth")
+    manifest, truth = validate_frozen_inputs(manifest_path, args.manifest_sha256, truth_path)
+    manifest_sha = sha256_file(manifest_path)
+    truth_sha = sha256_file(truth_path)
+    harness_sha = sha256_file(Path(__file__).resolve())
+    expected_ids = [row["question_id"] for row in manifest["questions"]]
+    source_index = candidate.predecessor.frozen.index_rows(manifest["questions"], "question_id", "source")
+    run_root = (args.run_root / args.run_id).resolve()
+    checkpoint = run_root / "checkpoint.jsonl"
+    completed = candidate.predecessor.frozen.index_rows(_load_rows(checkpoint), "question_id", "checkpoint")
+    if set(completed) - set(expected_ids):
+        raise RuntimeError("checkpoint_foreign_membership_global_stop")
+    for question_id, row in completed.items():
+        validate_terminal_row(row, question_id=question_id, run_id=args.run_id, manifest_sha=manifest_sha, truth_sha=truth_sha, harness_sha=harness_sha)
+    contract = read_json(CONTEXT_CONTRACT)
+    base_url = (args.base_url or contract["provider"]["base_url"]).rstrip("/")
+    if base_url != contract["provider"]["base_url"].rstrip("/"):
+        raise RuntimeError("provider_endpoint_drift_global_stop")
+    key = os.environ.get("AI2_VLM_API_KEY", "")
+    if not key and args.api_key_file:
+        key = args.api_key_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
+    if not key:
+        raise RuntimeError("local_api_key_missing_global_stop")

It checks exact 340-row checkpoint membership before replay, requires neither `AI2_VLM_API_KEY` nor provider preflight, and records provider_calls=0. The integration verification was run with the API key environment variable removed; a focused test also proves complete-checkpoint membership can be validated with no key. +def render_and_extract(
+    row: dict[str, Any], paper_count: int, freeze_root: Path,
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any], list[int]]:
+    """Render an authoritative chain and extract literal labels/marks.
+
+    Unlike the older holdout helper, this permits printed instruction labels
+    with no mark directly attached (for example (ii) followed by (a)/(b)).
+    Ownership still comes only from the nearest preceding printed label and is
+    subsequently confirmed on the contact sheet.
+    """
+    fitz = historical._fitz()
+    source_pdf = REPO / row["source_pdf"]
+    question_number = row["question_number"]
+    regions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    label_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, str]] = []
+    mark_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, int]] = []
+    current_parent: str | None = None
+    with fitz.open(str(source_pdf)) as document:
+        headers = historical.question_headers(document, paper_count)
+        start_page, start_y = headers[question_number]
+        next_header = headers.get(question_number + 1)
+        navigation_pages = row["navigation_page_indices"]
+        if start_page != navigation_pages[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"navigation_start_page_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if next_header:
+            next_page, next_y = next_header
+            last_page = next_page - 1 if next_page > start_page and next_y < 120 else next_page
+            pages = list(range(start_page, last_page + 1))
+        else:
+            last_mark_pages = [
+                page_index for page_index in range(start_page, len(document))
+                if any(historical.MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(word[4])) for word in document[page_index].get_text("words"))
+            ]
+            if not last_mark_pages:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"last_question_authoritative_end_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            pages = list(range(start_page, max(last_mark_pages) + 1))
+        pages = [page_index for page_index in pages if "BLANK PAGE" not in document[page_index].get_text().upper()]
+        if not pages or pages[0] != start_page:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_question_pages_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for ordinal, page_index in enumerate(pages, 1):
+            page = document[page_index]
+            top = max(42.0, start_y - 8.0) if page_index == start_page else 42.0
+            bottom = min(float(page.rect.height) - 35.0, 807.0)
+            if next_header and next_header[0] == page_index:
+                bottom = min(bottom, next_header[1] - 8.0)
+            if bottom <= top:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_crop_geometry_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            box = [0.0, round(top, 3), round(float(page.rect.width), 3), round(bottom, 3)]
+            pixmap = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0), clip=fitz.Rect(*box), alpha=False)
+            payload = pixmap.tobytes("png")
+            crop_path = freeze_root / "crops" / row["paper_id"] / row["question_id"] / f"region-{ordinal:02d}-page-{page_index + 1:02d}.png"
+            candidate.predecessor.frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(crop_path, payload)
+            regions.append({
+                "region_id": f"{row['question_id']}:region:{ordinal}",
+                "page_number": page_index + 1, "crop_box_pdf_points": box,
+                "crop_external_path": str(crop_path.resolve()), "crop_sha256": sha256_bytes(payload),
+                "render_engine": "PyMuPDF", "render_scale": 2.0,
+            })
+            clip = fitz.Rect(*box)
+            for word in page.get_text("words", clip=clip):
+                x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_rest = word
+                label_match = historical.LABEL_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if label_match and x0 < 180:
+                    label = label_match.group(1).lower()
+                    if label in historical.ROMANS and current_parent:
+                        label = f"{current_parent}({label})"
+                    elif label not in historical.ROMANS:
+                        current_parent = label
+                    label_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), label))
+                mark_match = historical.MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if mark_match:
+                    mark_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), int(mark_match.group(1))))
+    visible: list[str] = []
+    for *_position, label in label_events:
+        if label not in visible:
+            visible.append(label)
+    marks = []
+    for page_index, y0, x0, value in mark_events:
+        preceding = [event for event in label_events if (event[0], event[1], event[2]) <= (page_index, y0 + 3.0, x0)]
+        owner = preceding[-1][3] if preceding else "question"
+        if owner != "question" and owner not in visible:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_owner_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        marks.append({"owner": owner, "marks": value})
+    if not marks:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_marks_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+    expected = {
+        "question_number": question_number, "visible_subparts": visible, "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": False, "foreign_annotation_present": False,
+    }
+    return regions, expected, pages

+def validate_expected(expected: Any, question_number: int, question_id: str) -> None:
+    keys = {
+        "question_number", "visible_subparts", "visible_marks",
+        "candidate_writing_present", "foreign_annotation_present",
+    }
+    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or set(expected) != keys:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_schema_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if type(expected["question_number"]) is not int or expected["question_number"] != question_number:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_question_identity_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    parts = expected["visible_subparts"]
+    marks = expected["visible_marks"]
+    if (
+        not isinstance(parts, list) or len(parts) != len(set(parts))
+        or any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in parts)
+        or not isinstance(marks, list) or not marks
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_structure_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    for row in marks:
+        if (
+            not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"owner", "marks"}
+            or not isinstance(row["owner"], str)
+            or row["owner"] not in ({"question"} | set(parts))
+            or type(row["marks"]) is not int or row["marks"] <= 0
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"truth_mark_owner_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if expected["candidate_writing_present"] is not False or expected["foreign_annotation_present"] is not False:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_clean_source_scalar_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+

+def prior_membership() -> tuple[set[str], dict[str, Any]]:
+    combined: list[str] = []
+    sources = []

+        rows = read_json(path).get(key)

+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_rows_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        ids = [row.get("question_id") for row in rows if isinstance(row, dict)]

+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")

+        sources.append({
+            "path": path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),

+        "unique_question_count": 462,
+        "duplicate_count": 0,
+        "empty_id_count": 0,

+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> tuple[str, int, int, int]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])(\d\d)_qp_([1-6])(\d)", paper_id)
+    if not match:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"paper_identity_invalid_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+    session, year, component, variant = match.groups()
+    return session, 2000 + int(year), int(component), int(variant)

+    return REPO / f"data/manifests/9709_p{component}_{session}_standard_001_page_chain_surface_v1.json"

+        papers.append({

+            "year": year, "variant": variant, "question_count": len(items),
+            "question_paper": {"path": str(qp_relative), "sha256": sha256_file(qp_path)},
+            "mark_scheme": {"path": ms_auth["source_path"], "sha256": sha256_file(ms_path)},
+            "selection_posture": "complete_official_qp_ms_pair",
+        })
+        for item in items:
+            question_id = f"{paper_id}_q{item['q_number']:02d}"
+            if question_id in prior:
+                overlap.append(question_id)
+            questions.append({
+                "question_id": question_id, "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "question_number": item["q_number"], "source_pdf": str(qp_relative),
+                "surface_manifest": manifest_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+                "surface_storage_key": item.get("storage_key"),
+                "navigation_page_indices": historical.navigation_page_indices(item),
+            })
+    counts = Counter(row["component"] for row in papers)
+    if overlap:
+        raise RuntimeError("prior_population_overlap_global_stop:" + ",".join(overlap))

+        raise RuntimeError(f"population_42_340_gate_failed_global_stop:{len(papers)}:{len(questions)}")
+    if set(counts) != {f"P{x}" for x in range(1, 7)}:

+    if len({row["session"] for row in papers}) < 3 or len({row["year"] for row in papers}) < 3:
+        raise RuntimeError("population_session_year_coverage_failed_global_stop")
+    source = {

+        "year_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(str(row["year"]) for row in papers).items())),
+        "prior_unique_exclusion_count": 462, "exact_overlap_count": 0,
+        "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(ids)),

+        "canonical_source_inventory": {
+            "path": CANONICAL_SOURCE_INVENTORY.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(CANONICAL_SOURCE_INVENTORY),

+def render_and_extract(
+    row: dict[str, Any], paper_count: int, freeze_root: Path,
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any], list[int]]:
+    """Render an authoritative chain and extract literal labels/marks.
+
+    Unlike the older holdout helper, this permits printed instruction labels
+    with no mark directly attached (for example (ii) followed by (a)/(b)).
+    Ownership still comes only from the nearest preceding printed label and is
+    subsequently confirmed on the contact sheet.
+    """
+    fitz = historical._fitz()
+    source_pdf = REPO / row["source_pdf"]
+    question_number = row["question_number"]
+    regions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    label_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, str]] = []
+    mark_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, int]] = []
+    current_parent: str | None = None
+    with fitz.open(str(source_pdf)) as document:
+        headers = historical.question_headers(document, paper_count)
+        start_page, start_y = headers[question_number]
+        next_header = headers.get(question_number + 1)
+        navigation_pages = row["navigation_page_indices"]
+        if start_page != navigation_pages[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"navigation_start_page_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if next_header:
+            next_page, next_y = next_header
+            last_page = next_page - 1 if next_page > start_page and next_y < 120 else next_page
+            pages = list(range(start_page, last_page + 1))
+        else:
+            last_mark_pages = [
+                page_index for page_index in range(start_page, len(document))
+                if any(historical.MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(word[4])) for word in document[page_index].get_text("words"))
+            ]
+            if not last_mark_pages:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"last_question_authoritative_end_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            pages = list(range(start_page, max(last_mark_pages) + 1))
+        pages = [page_index for page_index in pages if "BLANK PAGE" not in document[page_index].get_text().upper()]
+        if not pages or pages[0] != start_page:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_question_pages_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for ordinal, page_index in enumerate(pages, 1):
+            page = document[page_index]
+            top = max(42.0, start_y - 8.0) if page_index == start_page else 42.0
+            bottom = min(float(page.rect.height) - 35.0, 807.0)
+            if next_header and next_header[0] == page_index:
+                bottom = min(bottom, next_header[1] - 8.0)
+            if bottom <= top:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_crop_geometry_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            box = [0.0, round(top, 3), round(float(page.rect.width), 3), round(bottom, 3)]
+            pixmap = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0), clip=fitz.Rect(*box), alpha=False)
+            payload = pixmap.tobytes("png")
+            crop_path = freeze_root / "crops" / row["paper_id"] / row["question_id"] / f"region-{ordinal:02d}-page-{page_index + 1:02d}.png"
+            candidate.predecessor.frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(crop_path, payload)
+            regions.append({
+                "region_id": f"{row['question_id']}:region:{ordinal}",
+                "page_number": page_index + 1, "crop_box_pdf_points": box,
+                "crop_external_path": str(crop_path.resolve()), "crop_sha256": sha256_bytes(payload),
+                "render_engine": "PyMuPDF", "render_scale": 2.0,
+            })
+            clip = fitz.Rect(*box)
+            for word in page.get_text("words", clip=clip):
+                x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_rest = word
+                label_match = historical.LABEL_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if label_match and x0 < 180:
+                    label = label_match.group(1).lower()
+                    if label in historical.ROMANS and current_parent:
+                        label = f"{current_parent}({label})"
+                    elif label not in historical.ROMANS:
+                        current_parent = label
+                    label_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), label))
+                mark_match = historical.MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if mark_match:
+                    mark_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), int(mark_match.group(1))))
+    visible: list[str] = []
+    for *_position, label in label_events:
+        if label not in visible:
+            visible.append(label)
+    marks = []
+    for page_index, y0, x0, value in mark_events:
+        preceding = [event for event in label_events if (event[0], event[1], event[2]) <= (page_index, y0 + 3.0, x0)]
+        owner = preceding[-1][3] if preceding else "question"
+        if owner != "question" and owner not in visible:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_owner_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        marks.append({"owner": owner, "marks": value})
+    if not marks:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_marks_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+    expected = {
+        "question_number": question_number, "visible_subparts": visible, "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": False, "foreign_annotation_present": False,
+    }
+    return regions, expected, pages
+
+
+def validate_expected(expected: Any, question_number: int, question_id: str) -> None:
+    keys = {
+        "question_number", "visible_subparts", "visible_marks",
+        "candidate_writing_present", "foreign_annotation_present",
+    }
+    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or set(expected) != keys:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_schema_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if type(expected["question_number"]) is not int or expected["question_number"] != question_number:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_question_identity_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    parts = expected["visible_subparts"]
+    marks = expected["visible_marks"]
+    if (
+        not isinstance(parts, list) or len(parts) != len(set(parts))
+        or any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in parts)
+        or not isinstance(marks, list) or not marks
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_structure_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    for row in marks:
+        if (
+            not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"owner", "marks"}
+            or not isinstance(row["owner"], str)
+            or row["owner"] not in ({"question"} | set(parts))
+            or type(row["marks"]) is not int or row["marks"] <= 0
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"truth_mark_owner_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if expected["candidate_writing_present"] is not False or expected["foreign_annotation_present"] is not False:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_clean_source_scalar_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+
+
+def prepare_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    papers, population_rows, source, exclusion = population()
+    freeze_root = (args.run_root / "frozen-inputs").resolve()
+    paper_counts = {row["paper_id"]: row["question_count"] for row in papers}
+    review_rows = []
+    for row in population_rows:
+        regions, expected, pages = render_and_extract(row, paper_counts[row["paper_id"]], freeze_root)
+        review_rows.append({
+            **row, "complete_page_chain": [region["page_number"] for region in regions],
+            "authoritative_page_indices": pages,
+            "navigation_page_chain_match": pages == row["navigation_page_indices"],
+            "regions": regions, "provisional_expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "pending_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+        })
+    sheets = []
+    for paper in papers:
+        rows = [row for row in review_rows if row["paper_id"] == paper["paper_id"]]
+        mark_total = sum(mark["marks"] for row in rows for mark in row["provisional_expected"]["visible_marks"])
+        expected_total = 75 if paper["component"] in {"P1", "P3"} else 50
+        if mark_total != expected_total:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"whole_paper_mark_total_mismatch_global_stop:{paper['paper_id']}:{mark_total}")
+        path = (args.run_root / "review-sheets" / f"{paper['paper_id']}.png").resolve()
+        sheets.append({
+            "paper_id": paper["paper_id"], "path": str(path),
+            "sha256": historical.build_contact_sheet(paper["paper_id"], rows, path),
+            "question_count": len(rows), "visible_mark_total": mark_total,
+            "authoritative_complete_page_chain_status": "pending_visual_confirmation",
+        })
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_generalization_holdout_visual_review_draft_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE, "candidate_responses_used": False, "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "component_freeze_sha256": sha256_file(COMPONENT_FREEZE),
+        "source": source, "exclusion_ledger": exclusion,
+        "papers": papers, "review_sheets": sheets, "rows": review_rows,
+    }
+    write_once(args.review_draft, payload)
+    return {
+        "status": "awaiting_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+        "review_draft": str(args.review_draft), "review_draft_sha256": sha256_file(args.review_draft),
+        "paper_count": len(papers), "question_count": len(review_rows), "provider_calls": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def accept_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if args.confirm != "candidate-blind-visual-review-complete":
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_confirmation_missing_global_stop")
+    draft = read_json(args.review_draft)
+    if sha256_file(args.review_draft) != args.review_draft_sha256:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    if draft.get("candidate_responses_used") is not False or draft.get("provider_call_count") != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_not_candidate_blind_global_stop")
+    overrides: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if args.overrides:
+        document = read_json(args.overrides)
+        rows = document.get("overrides")
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            raise RuntimeError("visual_review_overrides_invalid_global_stop")
+        for row in rows:
+            question_id = row.get("question_id")
+            if not isinstance(question_id, str) or question_id in overrides:
+                raise RuntimeError("visual_review_override_identity_invalid_global_stop")
+            overrides[question_id] = row.get("expected")
+    known = {row["question_id"] for row in draft["rows"]}
+    if set(overrides) - known:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_foreign_override_global_stop")
+    rows = []
+    for row in draft["rows"]:
+        expected = overrides.get(row["question_id"], row["provisional_expected"])
+        validate_expected(expected, row["question_number"], row["question_id"])
+        rows.append({
+            **row, "provisional_expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "accepted_candidate_blind_complete_page_chain_visual_review",
+            "truth_override_applied": row["question_id"] in overrides,
+        })
+    sheets = [
+        {**row, "authoritative_complete_page_chain_status": "visually_confirmed"}
+        for row in draft["review_sheets"]
+    ]
+    review = {
+        **draft,
+        "schema_version": "9709_generalization_holdout_candidate_blind_visual_review_v1",
+        "review_status": "accepted",
+        "review_method": "codex_visual_inspection_of_every_authoritative_complete_question_page_chain_contact_sheet",
+        "reviewed_question_count": len(rows), "reviewed_paper_count": len(sheets),
+        "truth_override_count": len(overrides), "review_sheets": sheets, "rows": rows,
+    }
+    write_once(args.review, review)
+    return {"status": "accepted", "path": str(args.review), "sha256": sha256_file(args.review), "overrides": len(overrides)}
+

+def freeze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    component_receipt = verify_component_freeze()
+    origin = git_value("rev-parse", "origin/main")
+    baseline = git_value("rev-parse", "baseline/origin-main")
+    task_base = git_value("merge-base", "HEAD", "origin/main")
+    if origin != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA or baseline != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA or task_base != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA:
+        raise RuntimeError("final_freeze_base_relationship_drift_global_stop")
+    review = read_json(args.review)
+    if review.get("review_status") != "accepted" or review.get("candidate_responses_used") is not False:
+        raise RuntimeError("accepted_candidate_blind_review_missing_global_stop")
+    papers, questions, source, exclusion = population()
+    reviewed = candidate.predecessor.frozen.index_rows(review.get("rows"), "question_id", "visual_review")
+    if set(reviewed) != {row["question_id"] for row in questions}:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_population_mismatch_global_stop")
+    frozen_questions = []

+def resolve_repo_file(path: Path, label: str) -> Path:
+    resolved = (path if path.is_absolute() else REPO / path).resolve()
+    try:

+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{label}_outside_repo_global_stop") from error
+    if not resolved.is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{label}_missing_global_stop")
+    return resolved

+def _attempt_paths(attempts_dir: Path, pass_name: str, number: int) -> tuple[Path, Path]:

+def _classify_raw(raw: bytes, budget: dict[str, Any], model: str) -> tuple[Any | None, dict[str, Any]]:
+    try:
+        document = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
+    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        return None, {"classification": "truncated_json", "semantic_eligible": False}
+    audit = candidate.audit_provider_response(document, budget)
+    if audit.get("semantic_eligible") is not True:
+        return None, audit
+    if document.get("model") != model:
+        return None, {
+            **audit, "classification": "provider_model_mismatch", "semantic_eligible": False,
+            "response_model": document.get("model"),
+        }
+    try:
+        parsed, _content = candidate.predecessor.frozen.base.parse_provider_response(document)
+    except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        return None, {**audit, "classification": "truncated_json", "semantic_eligible": False}
+    return parsed, {**audit, "response_model": document.get("model")}
